menu:504500062:1.text: Wow, this is definitely a major discovery...

say:0:1061801001:0.text: These things must be worth a fortune!
say:0:1061801001:0.source_cn: 这些东西肯定价值连城！

say:1:1061802001:1.text: Revered Magister! I knew we would meet again!
say:1:1061802001:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人！我就知道我们还会见面的！
say:1:1061802001:1.male: Revered Magister! I knew we would meet again!
say:1:1061802001:1.female: Revered Magister! I knew we would meet again!

say:2:1061802002:1.text: This time, I stumbled upon some great finds, all of them priceless antiques!
say:2:1061802002:1.source_cn: 这一次我可找到了不少好东西，都是价值连城的古董！
say:2:1061802002:1.male: This time, I stumbled upon some great finds, all of them priceless antiques!
say:2:1061802002:1.female: This time, I stumbled upon some great finds, all of them priceless antiques!

choice_prompt:3:1061802002.text: This time, I stumbled upon some great finds, all of them priceless antiques!
choice_prompt:3:1061802002.source_cn: 这一次我可找到了不少好东西，都是价值连城的古董！
choice_prompt:3:1061802002.male: This time, I stumbled upon some great finds, all of them priceless antiques!
choice_prompt:3:1061802002.female: This time, I stumbled upon some great finds, all of them priceless antiques!

say:4:1061802003:1.text: I just got lucky is all.
say:4:1061802003:1.male: I just got lucky is all.
say:4:1061802003:1.female: I just got lucky is all.

say:5:1061802005:1.text: Look for yourself! I found all these clay pots in the cave.
say:5:1061802005:1.source_cn: 请看这里！这些瓦罐都是我在洞穴里找到的。
say:5:1061802005:1.male: Look for yourself! I found all these clay pots in the cave.
say:5:1061802005:1.female: Look for yourself! I found all these clay pots in the cave.

say:6:1061802006:1.text: There weren't just clay pots in there. I saw makeshift sleeping mats and traces of campfire... Do you know what that means?
say:6:1061802006:1.source_cn: 不只是罐子，这样的东西还有很多，简易地铺和生火的痕迹。...
say:6:1061802006:1.male: There weren't just clay pots in there. I saw makeshift sleeping mats and traces of campfire... Do you know what that means?
say:6:1061802006:1.female: There weren't just clay pots in there. I saw makeshift sleeping mats and traces of campfire... Do you know what that means?

say:7:1061802007:1.text: People once lived in that cave! This is a major archaeological find! I'll make a fortune for unearthing these antiques!
say:7:1061802007:1.source_cn: ——这意味着曾经有人居住在洞穴中，这绝对是考古学的重大...
say:7:1061802007:1.male: People once lived in that cave! This is a major archaeological find! I'll make a fortune for unearthing these antiques!
say:7:1061802007:1.female: People once lived in that cave! This is a major archaeological find! I'll make a fortune for unearthing these antiques!

choice_prompt:8:1061802007.text: People once lived in that cave! This is a major archaeological find! I'll make a fortune for unearthing these antiques!
choice_prompt:8:1061802007.source_cn: ——这意味着曾经有人居住在洞穴中，这绝对是考古学的重大发现！而发掘这些古物的我，将会大赚一笔！
choice_prompt:8:1061802007.male: People once lived in that cave! This is a major archaeological find! I'll make a fortune for unearthing these antiques!
choice_prompt:8:1061802007.female: People once lived in that cave! This is a major archaeological find! I'll make a fortune for unearthing these antiques!

say:9:1061802008:1.text: Of course! Who would live in a cave otherwise?!
say:9:1061802008:1.source_cn: 当然！不然谁会住在洞穴里！
say:9:1061802008:1.male: Of course! Who would live in a cave otherwise?!
say:9:1061802008:1.female: Of course! Who would live in a cave otherwise?!

say:10:1061802009:1.text: Look at this carefully! There are marks on this jar indicating ancient methods of craftsmanship!
say:10:1061802009:1.source_cn: 请仔细看一看，这只瓦罐上还有古人加工过的挫痕！
say:10:1061802009:1.male: Look at this carefully! There are marks on this jar indicating ancient methods of craftsmanship!
say:10:1061802009:1.female: Look at this carefully! There are marks on this jar indicating ancient methods of craftsmanship!

say:11:1061802010:1.text: Oh, wait... The craftsmanship is too precise, and the cross-section is new...
say:11:1061802010:1.source_cn: 呃……不，这做工精度太精细了，断面也是新的……
say:11:1061802010:1.male: Oh, wait... The craftsmanship is too precise, and the cross-section is new...
say:11:1061802010:1.female: Oh, wait... The craftsmanship is too precise, and the cross-section is new...

say:12:1061802011:1.text: Alright... Perhaps they were left by locals seeking shelter in the caves. This is a disappointment...
say:12:1061802011:1.source_cn: 好吧……也许这些是当地人在山洞里避雨时留下的，真是白高...
say:12:1061802011:1.male: Alright... Perhaps they were left by locals seeking shelter in the caves. This is a disappointment...
say:12:1061802011:1.female: Alright... Perhaps they were left by locals seeking shelter in the caves. This is a disappointment...

say:13:1061802012:1.text: I loaded them up in my shipping crates. It was tough to squeeze everything in. Now I'll have to rearrange everything again...
say:13:1061802012:1.source_cn: 我装了好多进货箱，都是好不容易才塞进去的，现在又要重新...
say:13:1061802012:1.male: I loaded them up in my shipping crates. It was tough to squeeze everything in. Now I'll have to rearrange everything again...
say:13:1061802012:1.female: I loaded them up in my shipping crates. It was tough to squeeze everything in. Now I'll have to rearrange everything again...

say:14:1061802013:1.text: Unless the wisest, most courteous Magister in the land could help me one more time? Please, I'm begging you!
say:14:1061802013:1.source_cn: 要不然……魔法师大人，再帮我一次吧！求求你了！
say:14:1061802013:1.male: Unless the wisest, most courteous Magister in the land could help me one more time? Please, I'm begging you!
say:14:1061802013:1.female: Unless the wisest, most courteous Magister in the land could help me one more time? Please, I'm begging you!

choice:8:0:1.text: How do you know these are antiques?
choice:8:0:1.male: How do you know these are antiques?
choice:8:0:1.female: How do you know these are antiques?

choice:3:1:2.text: Why am I a bit skeptical...?
choice:3:1:2.male: Why am I a bit skeptical...?
choice:3:1:2.female: Why am I a bit skeptical...?

say:1:1061803001:1.text: So fast! You truly are the wisest Magister in the land!
say:1:1061803001:1.source_cn: 好快——！不愧是魔法师大人！
say:1:1061803001:1.male: So fast! You truly are the wisest Magister in the land!
say:1:1061803001:1.female: So fast! You truly are the wisest Magister in the land!

say:2:1061803002:1.text: Fortune always smiles on me when you're around!
say:2:1061803002:1.source_cn: 果然，只要遇见你就会发生好事！
say:2:1061803002:1.male: Fortune always smiles on me when you're around!
say:2:1061803002:1.female: Fortune always smiles on me when you're around!

choice_prompt:3:1061803002.text: Fortune always smiles on me when you're around!
choice_prompt:3:1061803002.source_cn: 果然，只要遇见你就会发生好事！
choice_prompt:3:1061803002.male: Fortune always smiles on me when you're around!
choice_prompt:3:1061803002.female: Fortune always smiles on me when you're around!

say:4:1061803003:1.text: I found them before you got here. Of course, that doesn't count.
say:4:1061803003:1.source_cn: 那是我遇见你之前发生的事，当然不算。
say:4:1061803003:1.male: I found them before you got here. Of course, that doesn't count.
say:4:1061803003:1.female: I found them before you got here. Of course, that doesn't count.

say:5:1061803004:1.text: But if you hadn't arrived, I'd probably have hauled this junk away, and for little profit at that.
say:5:1061803004:1.source_cn: 可是如果没遇到你，我恐怕会背着这些破烂走好长的路，还卖...
say:5:1061803004:1.male: But if you hadn't arrived, I'd probably have hauled this junk away, and for little profit at that.
say:5:1061803004:1.female: But if you hadn't arrived, I'd probably have hauled this junk away, and for little profit at that.

say:6:1061803006:1.text: It seems like I lack the skill to appraise items. It might be best if I stay out of the antique business.
say:6:1061803006:1.source_cn: 看来我没有鉴赏方面的天赋，还是不做古董生意为好。
say:6:1061803006:1.male: It seems like I lack the skill to appraise items. It might be best if I stay out of the antique business.
say:6:1061803006:1.female: It seems like I lack the skill to appraise items. It might be best if I stay out of the antique business.

say:7:1061803007:1.text: I wonder how long I'll have to slug along with these small ventures before I can join the Mithril Consortium...
say:7:1061803007:1.source_cn: 不知道这种小本买卖要做到什么时候，才能加入秘银商会呢………
say:7:1061803007:1.male: I wonder how long I'll have to slug along with these small ventures before I can join the Mithril Consortium...
say:7:1061803007:1.female: I wonder how long I'll have to slug along with these small ventures before I can join the Mithril Consortium...

say:9:1061803005:1.text: Come on now, at least I always compensate you...
say:9:1061803005:1.source_cn: 哎呀，至少我会付给你丰厚的酬劳嘛……
say:9:1061803005:1.male: Come on now, at least I always compensate you...
say:9:1061803005:1.female: Come on now, at least I always compensate you...

choice:3:1:2.text: How about asking someone else next time?
choice:3:1:2.male: How about asking someone else next time?
choice:3:1:2.female: How about asking someone else next time?
